brandAuthority.name: Territorial Control
brandAuthority.description: Establish economic and military dominance across the galaxy by converting 70% of all systems to Brand Authority loyalty.
brandAuthority.trackingNote: Systems with loyalty=brandAuthority and loyaltyValue>=60 / total systems * 100

brandAuthority.name: Military Elimination
brandAuthority.description: Crush all opposition through overwhelming military might. Destroy Union's secret base, eliminate all Union fleets, capture all Autoforge capital systems, and destroy all Autoforge fleets.

brandAuthority.name: Economic Dominance
brandAuthority.description: Achieve unassailable economic supremacy by accumulating 500,000 credits and controlling 50% of all trade hubs in the galaxy.

brandAuthority.name: Discovery Victory
brandAuthority.description: Eliminate the rebel threat by locating and destroying the Union's hidden stronghold. Intelligence operations and interrogation can reveal the base location.

discoveryMechanics.description: 15% via espionage mission in Union territory, 50% via captured character interrogation, 5% per turn passive intercept

union.name: Cumulative Loyalty
union.description: Win the hearts and minds of the galaxy through persistent grassroots organizing. Accumulate 5,000 total loyalty points across all Union-influenced systems.

union.name: Survival Victory
union.description: Outlast the oppressors and prove the resistance endures. Survive 100 turns with your secret base intact and maintain 30% galaxy control.

union.name: Liberation Victory
union.description: Free the oppressed systems from corporate tyranny. Convert 50 Brand Authority systems to Union loyalty through direct liberation campaigns.
union.trackingNote: Counts Brand Authority → Union loyalty transitions only. Neutral → Union does not count.

union.name: Heroic Victory
union.description: Ignite the spark of revolution that liberates the entire galaxy. Complete the five-mission revolutionary chain to awaken the people.

autoforge.name: System Dependency
autoforge.description: Create universal dependence on automated technology. Establish deep Autoforge dependency (≥50 score) in 60% of all galaxy systems.

autoforge.name: Research Victory
autoforge.description: Achieve technological singularity by completing every technology in the Autoforge research tree.

autoforge.name: Manufacturing Victory
autoforge.description: Demonstrate industrial supremacy through mass production. Cumulatively produce 1,000 units — ships, facilities, and droid units all count.
autoforge.trackingNote: Cumulative, never decrements. Counts ships, facilities, droid units.

autoforge.name: Peaceful Victory
autoforge.description: Prove coexistence through technological symbiosis. Maintain 75 consecutive turns without aggression while controlling 25% of the galaxy.
